name: pug-game-shop-tcg-store-platform
description: Trading card store platform development, testing, staging, and deployment tooling.

scripts.wp-env:test: wp-env run tests-cli phpunit || node scripts/wp-env/report-pending-phpunit.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:local && npm run test:sync-engine && npm run test:pos-payments && npm run test:api-client && npm run test:offline-app && npm run test:packaging && npm run test:required-matrix
scripts.test:local: cd apps/wordpress-plugin && php tests/run.php && php tests/bootstrap-smoke.php && php tests/lint.php
scripts.test:offline-app: node apps/offline-app/tests/windows-package-contract.mjs && node apps/offline-app/tests/sqlite-schema-contract.mjs && node apps/offline-app/tests/workspace-state-contract.mjs && node apps/offline-app/tests/queue-bridge-contract.mjs && node apps/offline-app/tests/local-queue-persistence-contract.mjs && node apps/offline-app/tests/tauri-command-contract.mjs && node apps/offline-app/tests/ui-shell-contract.mjs
scripts.test:packaging: node scripts/tests/wordpress-package-contract.mjs && node scripts/tests/staging-upload-contract.mjs && node scripts/tests/staging-inventory-smoke-contract.mjs && node scripts/tests/staging-migration-rehearsal-contract.mjs && node scripts/tests/staging-search-benchmark-contract.mjs && node scripts/tests/scrydex-live-smoke-contract.mjs
scripts.test:wordpress: npm run wp-env:start && npm run wp-env:test
